title: Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 – Blocks A, B & C Buyer Guide
description: Explore Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 Blocks A, B and C in one clean guide with resale-property checks, map guidance and WhatsApp availability.
intro: Phase 1 is the established F-18 project. Instead of separate thin block pages, this guide keeps Blocks A, B and C together so buyers can compare current resale plots, houses and rentals without mixing them with Phase 2 sectors.
body:
## Block A

Block A is part of the established Phase 1 / F-18 project. For any resale plot or house, compare the exact street, road width, construction around the property, dues and possession status rather than relying on a generic block-level price.

## Block B

Block B should be evaluated the same way: exact plot or house, road position, property condition, dues and seller demand. Current availability changes quickly, so ask for live options rather than an old listing list.

## Block C

Block C is also part of the established Phase 1 structure. Buyers should compare location, surrounding development and total transaction cost with A and B based on the exact property being offered.

## Plots, houses and rentals

Phase 1 can serve several intents: resale plots, ready houses and rental searches. Tell us the property type first so the inquiry can be filtered by block, budget and size instead of returning mixed inventory.

## How to compare Phase 1 properties

For plots, compare plot number, size, road width, corner status and dues. For houses, add construction condition, covered area, utilities and possession. For rentals, add bedrooms, furnished/unfurnished preference and move-in timing.

## Phase 1 vs Phase 2

Phase 1 is an established block-based project with resale property activity. Phase 2 is a newer sector-based project with current developer-style price offers. Keep the two searches separate so price and availability are not mixed.
